newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 23.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 23.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- Gas prices will rise by 11.3 percent, and electricity prices by 4.5 percent next week.

-- Opposition Smallholder's Party (FKGP) President Jozsef Torgyan said he would initiate police action against persons who suggested that he had connection with the secret police of the communist regime.

-- The opposition Christian Democrat Party (KDNP) said it did not expect any of its MP's to announce to leave the party at today's meeting, although some analysts forecast a split following the reelection of Gyorgy Giczy as party president.
-- Hails and rain-showers caused substantial damage in south Hungary.
-- The Foreign Ministry has inquired from Croatian officials if a letter, in which Croatia claimed $1 million from Hungary due to cancelled arms transports in 1991, was authentic.
